name: Replit Cloud Agents
desc: Agents that turn plain-language requests into tested pull requests on your repositories.
desc_zh: 把大白话需求变成仓库里经过测试的 Pull Request 的智能体。
solves: The people who know what to fix are rarely the ones who can ship it; they describe the change and an agent delivers a tested pull request.
solves_zh: 最清楚该改什么的人往往改不了；他们描述改动，智能体交出测过并附运行录像的 PR。
best_for: A designer spots a spacing bug that has been wrong for months and wants it fixed this week.
best_for_zh: 设计师发现一个错了好几个月的间距问题，想这周就修掉。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — replit.com/blog）。 Only the month is stated in the first-party post (Oct 27, 2026), so date_precision is month and released is the first of that month. That Oct 27 post widened access to all Pro and Enterprise customers; the capability itself rolled out at the start of March 2026. Distinct from the ledger’s Replit Agent, which builds new apps rather than contributing to an existing codebase. 首次公开日期来源：https://replit.com/blog/anyone-can-bring-ideas-to-company-codebase 首次公开日期仅精确到月。
